kurzbeschreibung: The Zillertal is world-renowned as the 'Valley of Music' and an alpine hotspot with 548 km of ski slopes and year-round skiing at Hintertux Glacier.
beschreibung: The Zillertal in the district of Schwaz is the broadest and most famous southern side valley of the Tyrolean Inn Valley. Stretching over 40 km from Strass through Fügen, Kaltenbach, Zell am Ziller, and Mayrhofen to Hintertux, it offers unmatched alpine variety. Crowned by the Hintertux Glacier—Austria's only 365-day year-round ski resort—and major networks including the Zillertal Arena, Mountopolis Mayrhofen (home to the legendary 78% gradient 'Harakiri' run), and Hochzillertal, winter sports enthusiasts enjoy 548 km of slopes. In summer, the High Alps Nature Park Zillertal Alps showcases turquoise reservoirs like Schlegeis, classic multi-day treks such as the Berlin High Trail, and mighty giants like Hochfeiler (3,509 m) and Olperer (3,476 m).
tipps: Hike up to the Olpererhütte at Schlegeis reservoir for the world-famous suspension bridge photo opportunity overlooking turquoise glacial waters.
Explore Nature's Ice Palace deep inside the Hintertux Glacier featuring an underground glacial lake and crystalline chambers.
Taste traditional Zillertaler Krapfen pastries and sharp Graukäse cheese at local alpine dairies.
empfehlungen: Ride the historic steam-powered Zillertal Railway (Zillertalbahn) from Jenbach to Mayrhofen. Then journey up to the awe-inspiring Schlegeis Reservoir or ascend to 3,250 m on the Hintertux Glacier, stopping for gourmet alpine dining at the acclaimed Wedelhütte or Kristallhütte.
umgebung: The Zillertal branches off southwards from the Inn Valley at Strass. It borders the Inn Valley and Rofan to the north, the Tux Alps and Wipptal to the west, Salzburg (Pinzgau via Gerlos Pass) and Kitzbühel Alps to the east, and South Tyrol (Italy) along the main Alpine ridge to the south.
